question: Identify the top 10 liquor categories in Iowa in 2021 by calculating, for each category, the average of the per-liter retail prices across all sales transactions in that category during 2021. For these top categories, provide their average per-liter retail prices calculated in the same manner for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
sql:
WITH top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        category_name,
        AVG(state_bottle_retail / SAFE_DIVIDE(bottle_volume_ml, 1000)) AS avg_2021
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
        AND bottle_volume_ml IS NOT NULL AND bottle_volume_ml > 0
    GROUP BY category_name
    ORDER BY avg_2021 DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS yr,
        AVG(s.state_bottle_retail / SAFE_DIVIDE(s.bottle_volume_ml, 1000)) AS avg_per_liter
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
    WHERE s.date >= '2019-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
        AND s.bottle_volume_ml IS NOT NULL AND s.bottle_volume_ml > 0
        AND s.category_name IN (SELECT category_name FROM top_categories)
    GROUP BY s.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date)
)
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_per_liter END) AS avg_2019,
    AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_per_liter END) AS avg_2020,
    AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2021 THEN avg_per_liter END) AS avg_2021
FROM category_sales c
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY avg_2021 DESC
